item.title: Fugitive on the run for years is arrested when he turns up at Olympics to watch hockey
item.description: A Slovak fugitive who had been on the run for 16 years was finally arrested when he turned up in Milan to support his national ice hockey team at the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics, police said Friday.

item.title: Federal agent injured in DTLA during protest against ongoing immigration raids
item.description: A federal agent was injured in downtown Los Angeles Friday after students walked out of class to protest the ongoing federal immigration raids.

item.title: 'The Secret Agent' star Wagner Moura making Oscars history: 'Beautiful moment for Brazilian culture'
item.description: Wagner Moura is making Oscars history. "The Secret Agent" star is the first Brazilian nominated for Best Actor. The recognition comes just one year after "I'm Still Here" became Brazil's first film to win Best International Feature at the Academy Awards.

item.title: Trump's Fort Bragg visit spotlights special forces who captured Venezuela's Maduro
item.description: Trump meet with military families and soldiers involved in the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.

item.title: Long Beach Rep. Robert Garcia slams DOJ's tracking of lawmakers' Epstein files searches
item.description: Congressman Robert Garcia, a Democrat from Long Beach, says he's outraged at what is still being kept secret after reviewing unredacted Epstein files.

item.title: SoCal to enjoy mild Valentine's Day weekend before powerful storm moves in
item.description: Enjoy a few more days of sunshine and mild temperatures before rainy weather arrives in Southern California next week.

item.title: DHS says it will appeal ruling that ended deportation case for OC father of 3 Marines
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security says it will appeal a ruling that ended the deportation case of an Orange County father of three U.S. Marines.

item.title: What to know about the Homeland Security shutdown starting this weekend
item.description: Another shutdown for parts of the federal government is expected this weekend as lawmakers debate new restrictions on President Donald Trump's immigration enforcement agenda.

item.title: Casey Wasserman selling his talent agency amid Epstein fallout
item.description: Casey Wasserman is selling his talent agency amid backlash over his ties to Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: Man shot outside Westfield Culver City mall; suspects at large
item.description: At least one person was shot outside the Westfield Culver City mall Friday evening, police said.
